title: The text discusses a conference of nationalities that is scheduled to take place in Lagos, Nigeria on December 17-19. The conference aims to deliberate on issues related to physical federalism, restructuring of federal institutions, and the drafting of a new constitution. The military commandant of Lagos State's anti-crime outfit, Operation Sweep, has threatened to deal decisively with members of the public who confront his men. The commandant justified the killing of three youths in Ereko area on Lagos Island, stating that his men had been facing confrontation from a group of criminals who set two of their patrol vehicles ablaze. The soldier emphasized that the squad was established by a statutory act of government with a statutory responsibility to protect lives and properties of Lagosians, fight all forms of robbery and violent crimes, and offer humanitarian services to the citizens. However, the soldier noted that his men had been subjected to derogatory comments by some sections of the press and members of the public who have been benefiting from violent crimes.
